title: Processing toxicogenomic raw data from GEO and ArrayExpress
author: Andreas Schüttler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s24eggw

steps.title: Retrieve and Filter GEO Metadata
steps.instruction: Use the R-package 'GEOmetadb' to retrieve metadata from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) for Danio rerio datasets of type 'Expression profiling by array'.

substeps.instruction: Load GEO metadata as a SQLite database using GEOmetadb::getSQLiteFile into the './data/' directory.
Query the database for Danio rerio datasets.
Assign 'agegroup' (embryo, adult, or cell_line) based on keywords in title, description, source name, or characteristics, and manually annotate specific GSE IDs.
Integrate chemical treatment information from './data/MetaData_curated/gse_chem.csv'.
Filter for embryo datasets with chemical treatment, removing amputation experiments and arrays from non-commercial manufacturers (MWG, NimbleGen).
Save the filtered dataset as './data/zfe_tox_geo.Rd'.
Generate and save an FTP download list for raw array data to './data/download_lists/ftp_download_list_geo.txt'.
Create a platform ID list (including GPL7244 as an alternative to GPL2878) and save it as './data/platformfiles_geo.Rd'.
Generate and save an FTP download list for platform SOFT files to './data/download_lists/ftp_download_list_platforms_geo.txt'.

steps.title: Retrieve and Filter ArrayExpress Metadata
steps.instruction: Use the 'ArrayExpress' R-package to retrieve and filter metadata for Danio rerio datasets.

substeps.instruction: Query ArrayExpress for 'danio+rerio' and remove sets already present in GEO.
Filter for datasets containing 'COMPOUND' in ExperimentFactors, excluding keywords like 'morpholino', 'morphilino', 'male', 'month', or 'cell-line'.
Manually remove specific studies (E-TABM-547, E-MEXP-2948, E-MEXP-1301, E-MEXP-818, E-TABM-105, E-MEXP-736, E-MTAB-43).
Retrieve SDRF metadata files via HTTPS for the selected IDs and combine them.
Filter out samples based on sex (male), developmental stage (adult), specific organism parts (heart, liver, extracardiac body tissue), and technology type (sequencing).
Save the metadata as './data/zfe_tox_ae.Rd'.
Generate and save an FTP download list for array data to './data/download_lists/ftp_download_list_ae.txt'.
Create a platform ID list and save it as './data/platformfiles_ae.Rd'.
Generate and save an FTP download list for platform ADF files to './data/download_lists/ftp_download_list_platforms_ae.txt', excluding Affymetrix IDs (A-GEOD-16933, A-GEOD-18967).

steps.title: Download Array and Platform Data
steps.instruction: Use Bash scripts to download the selected raw data and platform files into the 'data' directory.

substeps.instruction: Download GEO raw data using the FTP list, untar the files, unzip .gz files, and remove the .tar archives.
Download ArrayExpress datasets using the FTP list, unzip the files, and remove the .zip archives.
Download GEO platform SOFT files and gunzip them.
Download ArrayExpress platform ADF files.
Download Affymetrix sequence information (ZebGene-1_1-st-v1.zv9.probe.fa.zip and Zebrafish.probe_fasta.zip) to './data/PlatformData/fasta/'.
Download the Danio rerio genome assembly (danRer11.2bit) to './data/genomedata/'.
Download cDNA and ncRNA fasta files (release-93) from Ensembl to './data/genomedata/'.

steps.title: Create Platform FASTA Files
steps.instruction: Convert the downloaded platform files from GEO and ArrayExpress into FASTA format for probe mapping.

substeps.instruction: Load platform information from './data/platformfiles_geo.Rd' and './data/platformfiles_ae.Rd'.
Process the platform columns files to generate .fa files in './data/PlatformData/fasta/'.

steps.title: Perform Probe Mapping with BLAT
steps.instruction: Map probes to the dRer11 genome version using the BLAT tool.

substeps.instruction: Run BLAT against the genome (danRer11.2bit) with parameters: -maxIntron=380000, -minIdentity=95, -tileSize=9, -stepSize=5, -minScore=19.
Run BLAT against cDNA (Danio_rerio.GRCz11.cdna.all.fa) with parameters: -maxIntron=0, -minIdentity=95, -tileSize=9, -stepSize=5, -minScore=19.
Run BLAT against ncRNA (Danio_rerio.GRCz11.ncrna.fa) with parameters: -maxIntron=0, -minIdentity=95, -tileSize=9, -stepSize=5, -minScore=19.
Convert the resulting .psl files to .bed files using the psl2fullBed.pl script with -fracIdentCO 0.95.

steps.title: Map Probes to Gene Annotations
steps.instruction: Assign Ensembl gene IDs to the probes using the BLAT results and functional annotations.

substeps.instruction: Process the BED files to identify unique and non-unique gene mappings.
For Affy_ST platforms, merge with transcript cluster data from 'ZebGene-1_1-st-v1.na33.zv9.probeset.csv'.
Retrieve functional annotations using toxprofileR::getBM_annotation via biomaRt.
Save the final annotation as an .Rds file in './data/PlatformData/final_annotation/'.

steps.title: Compile Targets and Comparisons
steps.instruction: Create a master targets data frame and a comparison table for logFC calculations by merging database metadata with manual curation.

substeps.instruction: Merge ArrayExpress metadata with './data/MetaData_curated/zfe_tox_ae_cure.csv'.
Merge GEO metadata with './data/MetaData_curated/zfe_tox_geo_cure.csv'.
Combine AE and GEO targets into 'zfe_tox_targets', removing samples marked for disregard.
Generate unique SampleNames based on substance, time (hpf), concentration, and unit.
Filter for 'OneColor' experimental designs and standardize concentration units (e.g., µm_L to µM_L, mg/l to mg_L).
Remove flawed datasets GSM668015 and GSM957452.
Create a 'comparisons_merge' table by pairing treatment and control samples based on study_id, gpl_id, exposure timing, tissue, and raw format.
Save the targets and comparisons to './data/targets_comparisons.Rd'.

steps.title: Normalize Raw Data
steps.instruction: Load raw data into R using 'toxprofileR' and perform normalization.

substeps.instruction: Iterate through unique study IDs in the targets file.
Read raw data using toxprofileR::read_raw_public with 'cyclicloess' between-array normalization.
Save the normalized data as individual .Rdata files in './data/ProcessedData/'.

steps.title: Generate logFC Matrix
steps.instruction: Calculate log-fold changes (logFC) for all normalized datasets and compile them into a final matrix.

substeps.instruction: Load the targets and comparisons file.
Calculate logFC for each comparison and combine them using a full join on 'ensembl_gene_id'.
Set 'ensembl_gene_id' as row names and save the final matrix as './data/ProcessedData/logFC_frame.Rd'.
